items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: And the original Tuxedo Band, there's four of us made up that band. Ernest Trepania, the drummer. William Risley and myself. And Oscar Salisant.

ctx.x: What were the four pieces? What instruments?

That was a violin, guitar, bass, and drum. No, cornet and drum. Violin, guitar, cornet and drum. I was playing violin. Louis Armstrong was playing cornet. And Tom Batten playing guitar. And Ernest Trepania, he used to call them the next.
